purpose: Test whether the frozen high-capacity/no-regularization recipe yields a large development generalization gain over the production MLP recipe. Development reuse is not pristine validation and is not a Kaggle result.
scope: Create files only under test/48_high_capacity_generalization. Do not modify src, other experiments, or Git history. Do not inspect or use historical heldout metrics for selection.

task2.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task2', seed=42, validation_session=s) for s in session1, session2, session3, in that order
task2.training: For each mouse independently, use every original trial in its other three complete sessions. Do not train on any trial from the target session.
task2.validation: The target session only. Session4 is never a Task2 validation fold.

task3.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task3', seed=s) for s in 20261126 and 20261127, in that order
task3.training: For each mouse independently, pool the four sessions after per-session normalization; each block has exactly three training trials per glyph.
task3.validation: Exactly one disjoint validation trial per glyph per block; no repeat aggregation.

normalization_and_rows.session_transform: log1p(max(raw_count,0)); mean and population std in float64; float32 mean/scale with scale floor 1e-5
normalization_and_rows.task2_train: Fit each training session normalizer on that fold's train_trials only. Include normalized original single-trial rows and, separately, normalized per-session/per-target four-repeat arithmetic-mean rows. Both row types have equal per-row weight in shuffled training.
normalization_and_rows.task2_validation: Fit the target-session normalizer on all its unlabeled validation trials. Use target labels only to locally simulate the official group_ptr by grouping each target's four repeats and averaging raw counts before applying that normalizer. Labels never generate, alter, rank, or assign predictions.
normalization_and_rows.task3_train: Fit each block normalizer on that block's train_trials only. Include original single-trial rows only; no mean rows or repeat merging.
normalization_and_rows.task3_validation: Apply the same block's train-fold normalizer to each single validation trial. Strictly no repeat merging and no validation-response normalizer fitting.
normalization_and_rows.model_second_normalization: SpikeClassifier.set_normalization on the concatenated training matrix for the current mouse/fold/arm only, with apply_log=False to avoid a second log1p. No validation rows enter this statistic.

shared_training_contract.row_order: np.random.default_rng(42 + epoch).permutation(n_train_rows), identical across arms for a fixed task/fold/mouse
shared_training_contract.mixed_precision: bfloat16 CUDA autocast and float32 cross entropy; float32 on CPU
shared_training_contract.other_methods: No early stopping, learning-rate search, seed search, architecture change, assignment during training, encoding/reranker fusion, image prior, or cross-mouse model.

checkpoint_evaluation.score_source: Raw float32 MLP logits only, in eval mode; no fusion, temperature tuning, or label-derived score modification.
checkpoint_evaluation.rows: Task2: the 256 locally repeat-averaged target rows. Task3: the 256 single-trial rows. Rows are sorted by target ID because the frozen subset is sorted.
checkpoint_evaluation.raw_top1_accuracy: Mean(raw argmax target == true target) over 256 rows.
checkpoint_evaluation.raw_recall_at_32: Mean(true target appears in stable argsort of descending raw logits[:32]) over 256 rows.
checkpoint_evaluation.raw_top1_official_ocf: Mean official OCF between gallery images at raw argmax IDs and true target images over 256 rows, including PNG-equivalent quantization through src.evaluation.score_predictions.
checkpoint_evaluation.hungarian: scipy linear_sum_assignment(maximize=True), through src.retrieval.unique_assignment, independently on each 256 x 2748 raw-logit submatrix. Assignment uses scores only and all 2748 columns remain available.
checkpoint_evaluation.assigned_final_ocf: Mean official OCF between gallery images at Hungarian-assigned IDs and true target images over the same 256 rows.
checkpoint_evaluation.aggregation: Retain every block/mouse/fold/epoch row. Average blocks within each mouse-fold, folds within each mouse, mice within each fold, and all mouse-fold cells for the macro average. All cells have equal 256-row block sizes.
checkpoint_evaluation.ocf_scale: Native official score scale; the +3 gate is an absolute difference on that scale.
checkpoint_evaluation.gallery_binarization: Match test/evaluate_final.py: binary_gallery = (uint8_gallery >= 128).astype(float32); official score_predictions performs its standard PNG-equivalent prediction quantization. This explicit correction follows a pre-metric binary-target exception and precedes every real OCF value.

selection.within_each_task_and_arm: Select one epoch shared by both mice and all folds. Maximize macro assigned_final_ocf; break exact ties in order by macro raw_recall_at_32, macro raw_top1_accuracy, then earlier epoch. raw_top1_official_ocf is reported but is not a selection key.
selection.between_arms: Compare the two selected-epoch macro summaries with the same ordered keys: assigned_final_ocf, raw_recall_at_32, raw_top1_accuracy, then earlier selected epoch.
selection.selection_inputs: Only the newly computed preregistered development metrics. No fixed-seed42 Task3 final evaluation, Task2 session4 evaluation, Kaggle submission, or historical heldout metric.

advancement_gate.comparison: Winner minus production_recipe, each at its own selected epoch, within each task.
advancement_gate.per_mouse: Both mouse-level assigned_final_ocf deltas (averaged over development folds) must be >= 0.
advancement_gate.folds: A strict majority of fold-level assigned_final_ocf deltas (averaged over the two mice) must be >= 0: at least 2/3 Task2 folds and 2/2 Task3 folds.
advancement_gate.outcome: If the high-capacity arm is not the winner or any condition fails, stop with advance=false. Do not search alternate hyperparameters. Passing development alone would still require a separately authorized pristine/final protocol; this experiment never performs it.

prohibited: Task2 session4 validation or final evaluation
historical heldout metrics for model, arm, or epoch selection
